CNV-ECO-004.finding: OD-M-17, OD-M-20 (owner decisions; OD-CDD-01, OD-CDD-04, OD-CDD-05)
CNV-ECO-004.append: Owner decisions of 2026-11-27 (PR #22 direction; OD-M-17, OD-M-20): the initial commercial route SHALL be partner-first, a module or capability inside an existing channel partner's offering followed by licensing (OD-CDD-01); the segment above is retained as the long-term destination, and partner-first commitments SHALL remain subject to the V-1 and V-6 evidence gates and to CNV-ECO-003. Revenue concentration SHALL be measured and disclosed at both end-sponsor and channel-partner level, and the concentration exception record above SHALL be required when either measure exceeds the cap (OD-CDD-05). The signed-anchor evidence gate of the approved DEC-002 SHALL apply to full-service administration, including the Unbound-operated administration offer of OD-M-08 where it is full-service, and SHALL NOT apply to limited operational support services (OD-CDD-04).
acceptance_add: Given a partner-first commitment proposed before V-1 and V-6 have reported, when it is submitted for approval, then it is refused.

Given one channel partner whose sponsors together exceed the concentration cap after year three, when the quarterly disclosure runs, then a concentration exception record is required even though no single end sponsor exceeds it.

Given a full-service administration offer proposed without the signed-anchor evidence, when it is submitted, then it is refused; and given a limited operational support service, then the anchor gate does not apply.

CNV-GRT-003.append: Owner decision of 2026-11-27 (PR #22 direction; OD-M-18, OD-CDD-02): within the deep-review interval above, whose ceiling is unchanged, the deep review MAY be satisfied by change-driven renewal: continuous monitoring of every monitorable eligibility predicate with no eligibility-relevant change, every non-monitorable evidence item within its freshness period, and targeted review of each changed or expired item. Event-triggered invalidation and approval- and release-time checks are unchanged. This clause does not decide who performs the deep review (open as OD-CDD-06).
acceptance_add: Given a charity with continuous monitoring, no eligibility-relevant change and all non-monitorable evidence within its freshness period at the end of the deep-review interval, when renewal runs, then the deep review is renewed with targeted review only of changed or expired items, and no renewal extends beyond the interval ceiling.
